concept: Serving without needing recognition or a public record of it
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.scenario: Student has an opportunity to help in a way that could be publicly recognized, or quietly with no acknowledgment at all
exercise.branching_choice: Student decides which approach to take and why
exercise.practice: Socratic follow-up on whether the choice would change if literally no one ever found out

assessment.success_marker: student reflects genuinely on the role recognition plays in their own motivation, without pretending it doesn't matter at all
